grammar_focus: 被动语态(be + 过去分词;主动变被动,KS10)——一般过去被动(was stolen / was picked up)、现在进行被动(is being sent)、过去完成被动(had been found)、ask sb to do 的被动(be asked to do)+ by 短语引出执行者(主考)+ most = very + 过去分词(most surprised)/ 句尾 too·as well 表'也'(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 丹·鲁宾逊焦虑了整整一个星期。上星期二他收到当地警察局的一封信,要他到警局去一趟。丹奇怪警察为什么找他,但昨天还是去了,结果不再担心了——一位面带微笑的警察告诉他,他的自行车找到了:5天前在400英里外的一个小村里被发现,现在正用火车给他运回家来。丹听到这消息非常吃惊,又觉得好笑,因为他从没指望那辆车还能找到——它是20年前丹还是个15岁孩子时被人偷走的!

grammar_card.title: 被动语态:be + 过去分词
grammar_card.intro: 被动语态用 be + 过去分词,表示'某事被…'。动作执行者用 by 引出。不同时态改 be:一般过去 was/were、现在进行 is/are being、过去完成 had been。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: 一般过去 → was/were + 过去分词
This bridge was built in 1942. / It was stolen.
现在进行 → is/are being + 过去分词
It is now being sent to his home.
过去完成 → had been + 过去分词
ask sb to do 的被动
I was asked to make a speech.

specialRules.rule: most = very,常与作形容词的过去分词连用:Dan was most surprised = 非常吃惊。
too / as well 放句尾表'也':He was amused too. / amused as well.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How long had the police taken to find his bicycle?
options: Twenty years — it was stolen when Dan was fifteen

passage: Dan Robinson has been worried all week. Last Tuesday he received a letter from the local police. In the letter, he was asked to call at the station. Dan wondered why he was wanted by the police, but he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried anymore. At the station, he was told by a smiling policeman that his bicycle had been found. Five days ago, the policeman told him, the bicycle was picked up in a small village four hundred miles away. It is now being sent to his home by train. Dan was most surprised when he heard the news. He was amused too, because he never expected the bicycle to be found. It was stolen twenty years ago when Dan was a boy of fifteen!
